I'm sorry your calathea is struggling. Unfortunately, the 90-day guarantee only applies to plants ordered while your Leafy Plus membership was active. Your calathea arrived 45 days ago, before you joined 10 days ago, so the standard 30-day guarantee applies, and that window closed about 15 days ago.

I can't offer a replacement under the policy. A Plant Care Specialist can give you free care advice by chat or email, which may help save it. If you'd like, I can also escalate your case to a Support Lead, though I can't promise any exception.
